desc: A fan-made RP Roblox game with @L.C’s stalker characters! This game is mostly inspired by the YouTuber @Twixxel_lesgo’s series, “I genuinely never been this scared.” This fan-made game is also inspired by the analog horror series, “The parallel.”  YouTuber @L.C is the original creator of these stalker characters so please support him and check out his content.
